items.label: Powerful Bass
items.value: soundcore P20i true wireless earbuds have oversized 10mm drivers that deliver powerful sound with boosted bass so you can lose yourself in your favorite songs.

items.label: Personalized Listening Experience
items.value: Use the soundcore app to customize the controls and choose from 22 EQ presets. With "Find My Earbuds", a lost earbud can emit noise to help you locate it.

items.label: Long Playtime, Fast Charging
items.value: Get 10 hours of battery life on a single charge with a case that extends it to 30 hours. If P20i true wireless earbuds are low on power, a quick 10-minute charge will give you 2 hours of playtime.

items.label: Portable On-the-Go Design
items.value: soundcore P20i true wireless earbuds and the charging case are compact and lightweight with a lanyard attached. It's small enough to slip in your pocket, or clip on your bag or keys–so you never worry about space.

items.label: AI-Enhanced Clear Calls
items.value: 2 built-in mics and an AI algorithm work together to pick up your voice so that you never have to shout over the phone.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: Instant Pairing: During first use, open the charging case, take soundcore P20i true wireless earbuds out and they will enter pairing mode. From then on, the earbuds will connect to the last paired device every time you use them.
